command_or_fixture: Read-only plan review: 24ax3 Boundaries, requirements 2.3, 5, 7 and AC-4 against spec_tool_permissions._codex, _claude, _read and assess, and render_platform_surfaces.selected_permission_rules.
counterexample_or_failure_condition: Implemented as written, upgrade writes the upgrade-verification receipt and serves the new spec tool while any of these restricts the old name: (1) a user-level Codex config ($CODEX_HOME/config.toml) lists the old name in disabled_tools, or has a tools.<old> approval table; requirement 5 defines holds only in Claude deny/ask terms and AC-4 tests only Claude; (2) a user-level or enterprise Claude deny or ask pattern matches the old name but not the new one, although the repository reader spec_tool_permissions._claude holds the same pattern via fnmatchcase (requirement 2.3, AC-5); (3) an outside file that exists but is unreadable or malformed 'holds no route', so a dotfiles-symlinked ~/.claude/settings.json read with follow_links=False (as spec_tool_permissions._read does) or a file with a BOM skips the user's deny while the host applies it.
expected: Every outside-layer restriction that the host can apply to the old name (Codex disabled_tools and tools.<old> tables, Claude deny/ask patterns matching old but not new, and outside files that exist but cannot be read or parsed) holds the route and suppresses the receipt, and AC-4 covers a Codex row.
known_bad_detection_method: Readiness attestation over the plan: the outside-layer rule was compared case by case with the repository reader's existing hold rules (spec_tool_permissions._codex, _claude, _read); the known-bad shapes (user Codex disabled_tools on an old name, symlinked user settings) are not held by requirement 5 as written.
limitations: Inferred from the plan text and the code; nothing was executed against a host. Whether Claude Code honors mid-name globs in MCP rules is unverified; whether the host strips a BOM is unverified. The Codex disabled_tools and the symlinked user file cases do not depend on either.
observed: Requirement 5 text names only exact deny/ask rules, defines no Codex mapping, and states that an unreadable or malformed outside file holds no route; AC-4 covers only Claude settings.json under CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and a managed-settings fixture.
proposition: 24ax3 requirement 5 holds a route only for an exact Claude-style deny or ask rule on the old name in an outside layer, which is narrower than its Boundary ('never serves a tool that a readable layer restricts under its old name without the same restriction on the new name').
public_path: Upgrade Phase 1 permissions render child (render_platform_surfaces.py --include-permissions) and the upgrade backstop, then server roster via mcp_tool_roster.spec_permission_holds -> spec_tool_permissions.assess -> _review_held accepting the new upgrade receipt body.
safety_and_authorization: Read-only review; no repository file edited apart from the lane's review file in the wave work folder; no real user, enterprise or system settings file read.

disposition_rationale: Required-AC correctness defect in a safety control: no less-trusted actor controls these operator-owned files (attacker reachability false), but the configurations are supported and the result serves a tool the operator's own policy restricted, contradicting the spec's Boundary. Bounded, safe repair: in requirement 5, reuse _codex and _claude matching in restriction-only mode for outside layers; read outside files read-only, following links; when an outside file exists but cannot be read or parsed, hold every route whose old name appears as a token in the readable bytes, or every route when no bytes are readable; add AC-4 rows for Codex disabled_tools, an outside pattern deny and a symlinked user file.
